findings.condition: A payment is approved while the AC-096 leave dialog is open (the N3 path) and the person then chooses stay
findings.description: No code moves focus to the confirmation heading once the dialog closes, and the unit test 'AC-096 an answer while a dialog is open...' only asserts focus stays in a fake dialog; nothing tests the state after stay. Recommendation: when the confirmation is shown while a dialog is open, move focus to STEP_HEADING_ID after that dialog closes (for example wait for the LeaveConfirmation pending promise, or check document.activeElement === body on the next render), and add a unit test for approve-during-dialog then stay
findings.impact: showConfirmation skips moving focus because a dialog is open; the dialog then restores focus to the pay button, which no longer exists because the confirmation replaced the summary. Focus falls to the document body instead of the confirmation title, so keyboard and screen reader users lose their place (AC-083 focus on the title; AC-034 focus returns after stay)
